title: Dharma Chakkaram
desc: Chakkaravarthy loses a challenge with Arumugam, which leads to his girlfriend sacrificing her life. Years later, Chakkaravarthy meets another woman who shares her name with his former lover.

title: Kodi Parakuthu
desc: A mafia leader tries to kill policeman Sivagiri, who took down his illegal businesses, with the help of a lookalike. Later, Sivagiri discovers that the leader is responsible for his father's death.

title: Sena
desc: Sena, a hardworking man, works for a criminal named Masthan, to help his brother Arvind in becoming a lawyer. Problems arise when Arvind is killed by Masthan for raising his voice against him.

title: Pokkiri Raja
desc: Sanjeev loses his job and his girlfriend leaves him due to his massive yawns. Later, he goes to a doctor to get himself cured and learns that he has inherited a superpower from his great-grandfather.
